candidate_merges.message: Use a direct connection for Mongo Express with single-member replica sets (#20571) ## Description `AddMongoDB("mongo").WithReplicaSet().WithMongoExpress()` gives a healthy MongoDB server, but its Mongo Express companion exits with code 1 after about 30 seconds: ```text MongoServerSelectionError: connect ECONNREFUSED ::1:27017 ``` `WithReplicaSet()` sets up the replica set with a `localhost:<port>` member address, which assumes clients will use `directConnection=true`.
